lessons.title: Match day
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, are you ready for the football match today?
Ben: Of course! Our team has practised for two weeks.
Anna: I'll cheer for you. Last year you were the champion.
Ben: Sport gives me energy and friends.
Anna: I love running too. Let's keep doing sports for life.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，今天足球比赛准备好了吗？
本：当然！我们队练了两周。
安娜：我给你加油，你去年是冠军呢。
本：运动让我有活力，有朋友。
安娜：我也爱跑步，一辈子坚持运动！

lessons.title: Sports for life
lessons.en: Sport is more than a game. Football and basketball teach us teamwork. Swimming and running build a strong body. Win or lose, every match makes us better. Champions are not born — they practise every day. Start a sport early and you'll stay healthy, full of energy, and friends, for your whole life.
lessons.cn: 运动不只是游戏。足球篮球教我们团队精神。游泳跑步强健体魄。无论输赢，每场比赛都让我们更好。冠军不是天生的——他们每天练。早开始一项运动，你一辈子都会健康、有活力、有朋友。
